title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - QoSMetric
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/QoSMetric. A quantity representing a performance level that is guaranteed to be met at least X% of the time. Top-level class with nine direct subclasses: BandWidth, RoundTripTime, Availability, PacketLoss, Jitter, Latency, TargetPercentile, Throughput, and IOPS.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'QoSMetric'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

metric.description: Relationship. Quantity usually representing a performance level. Links to a QuantityKind entity.

guaranteed.description: Property. Minimum percentage of time where a performance-level is guaranteed to be met (FloatPercentage, 0-100).
